title: 4 things that just make sense when you run a *cleaning* business

items.title: Every renewal date in one place
items.body: Business license, liability policy, bond, van registration. One list.

items.title: A current COI ready to send
items.body: Holiday office cleans start with 'send your insurance certificate.'

items.title: Reminders 30 days out, not 3
items.body: Renewals take longer than you think in December.

items.title: Checking the date before you hit send
items.body: An expired COI is still a PDF. It just says 2025.
